title: Check that a peer responds
summary: WebSockets: Check that a peer responds. Change the text sent after pong.
introduction: Ping and pong are control messages. The ws client automatically answers a ping with pong.
learningObjectives: Check that a peer responds with WebSockets
Change the text sent after pong

blocks.text: Run npm init -y and npm install ws@8 in a practice folder. Save each example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. Each file starts a local server and test client, prints a result, then closes both.

blocks.title: Check that a peer responds

blocks.text: The ws client answers the ping automatically. Receiving pong causes the server to send Still here.
Change the text sent after pong.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A real heartbeat needs a timeout for peers that never answer.
